text:
maria: ok serious question: who told Muffin the ferret that ficus leaves are a chaise lounge? posted a pic: https://imgur.com/a/ferretficus :laughing:

luc: that's not a nap, that's a full-on canopy hammock. absolute showboat. :clap:

anya: i love his little nose peeking out. is he judging the plant? :thinking_face:

maria: i think he's conducting an audit on sunlight placement. he takes his QA very seriously.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please don't let office animals on keyboards during deploy windows. Next deploy window: 3/8 09:30-10:00 UTC.

luc: noted. Muffin has agreed to wear a tiny vest labeled "on call" during those times.

anya: poll: should we rename the ficus to "Muffin's Lounge"? vote with emoji. :palm_tree:

maria: :thumbsup: rename it 

luc: :heart: yes

maria: fun fact: Muffin has perfected the one-paw loaf, patented last Tuesday. will demonstrate at lunch.

giphy: GIF: ferret flops dramatically (posted)

anya: bringing a tiny toy crown for ceremony. who else is in? :crown:

luc: i'll bring confetti (biodegradable).

maria: i'll bring the ceremonial snack dish. small bits only.

anya: also, unsolicited request: someone make a 10-second slow-mo of his nap for socials? it's peak content.

maria: yes please. tag marketing if you share. :camera_with_flash:

luc: Muffin sends regards and a sniff. (reacts: :heart: from anya, :laughing: from luc)
